falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern match would be invalidated because the August 2024 bottom was followed by a sustained recovery, not an immediate reversal to new highs; this would signal a V-bottom rather than the distribution/bottoming process implied by the pattern

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14 for 3 consecutive days within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score of 40 typically accompanies elevated volatility; sustained VIX compression below 14 would indicate fear has fully flushed and the market has entered complacency, invalidating the 'bottom in progress' signal and suggesting the low was already made

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 40 basis points from its level at pattern match trigger to any close within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom coincided with a flight-to-quality bid in bonds; a sharp rally in Treasuries without equity follow-through would indicate macro stress transmission rather than a durable equity bottom, breaking the pattern's risk-on recovery sequence

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
